subject.title: fix: verify provider SSH host keys

question: Should this PR land with verified provider SSH host identity by default and no insecure compatibility flag after the release-only cleanup bug is fixed and live provider proof is posted?
rationale: The change repairs a documented SSH server-authentication boundary but may make existing provider workflows fail closed when host identity is unstable, so maintainer intent is needed beyond unit-test correctness.

options.title: Verify by default after proof
options.body: Fix the release-only side effect, require redacted Namespace Instance plus remaining provider proof, remove the changelog edit, and then land fail-closed host-key pinning.

options.title: Add a narrow escape hatch
options.body: Keep the security fix but require an explicit, documented opt-in only for provider paths that cannot yet provide stable host identity.

options.title: Pause for provider identity design
options.body: Hold the PR if live proof shows provider host-key instability that needs provider-supplied fingerprints or a different trust root.

recommendation.title: Verify by default after proof
recommendation.body: Fix the release-only side effect, require redacted Namespace Instance plus remaining provider proof, remove the changelog edit, and then land fail-closed host-key pinning.
